Three untold secrets.|Back cover|[[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']]}} '''''Secrets of the Jedi''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]]. Like its predecessor, ''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]'', it explores the relationships between three generations of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and it prominently features [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. ''Secrets of the Jedi'' was published in [[March]] [[2005]] by [[Scholastic]], and it was [[Legacy of the Jedi/Secrets of the Jedi omnibus|republished]] with ''Legacy of the Jedi'' in [[2006]].
